notes: Validated against Russo Krauss et al. Nucleic Acids Res 2012 (doi:10.1093/nar/gks1001) and Padmanabhan & Tulinsky 1996 Acta Crystallogr D. T6/HD1 is a 15-mer DNA G-quadruplex aptamer (thrombin-binding aptamer, TBA). SPECIAL CASE: T6 is the LIGAND (DNA aptamer), thrombin protein is the RECEPTOR — reversed from the typical riboswitch setup. BINDING MECHANISM: The aptamer's TT loops dock into exosite I (fibrinogen-recognition exosite) of thrombin. Primary contacts: Arg75 and Tyr76 hydrophobic pocket with TT loop thymines; Arg77A salt bridge to Gua2 backbone phosphate; Asn78 H-bonds thymine N3; Ile79 hydrophobic. Secondary contact: Arg97 cation-π with TGT loop Thy9. The G-quartet is mostly solvent-exposed; electrostatic interactions dominate. Note: Vina scores this poorly (DNA-protein scoring not calibrated) — kept as calibration reference, not enrichment target.
